preconditions.description: The number of planets N is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of Hyperspace™ highways M is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i < v_i <= N for u_i, v_i in highways)
preconditions.description: Each highway connects two different planets u_i and v_i where 1 ≤ u_i < v_i ≤ N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_j < b_j <= N for a_j, b_j in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query asks for the minimal number of Hyperspace™ highways between two different planets a_j and b_j where 1 ≤ a_j < b_j ≤ N.

postconditions.description: The number of results is equal to the number of queries Q.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and result >= 0 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer representing the minimal number of Hyperspace™ highways needed for the corresponding query.
